entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: The state entered at the UE when the initial registration procedure is performed by the UE.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE that leads to entering the 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs the initial registration procedure and enters the 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: Substate behavior
entities.description: Behavior of the UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state according to the substate as explained in subclause 5.2.3.2.

relations.description: Performing the initial registration procedure establishes the 5GMM-REGISTERED state at the UE.
The UE performs the initial registration procedure.
In state 5GMM-REGISTERED, the UE shall behave according to the substate.
